points.description: Correct Tustin-discretised difference equation with numerical coefficients to 3 s.f.: y_k = 0.0591(u_k + u_{k-1}) + 0.882 y_{k-1} (b0 = b1 = κ/(1+κ) ≈ 0.0591, a1 = (κ−1)/(1+κ) ≈ −0.882, κ = ωcT/2 = 0.0628, ωc=2π·20, T=1 ms). Both feedforward and feedback coefficients must be correct; equivalent forms accepted. Wrong or missing coefficients (e.g. wrong sign of the y_{k-1} term, or no prewarping error beyond tolerance) earn 0.
DC gain evaluated at z = 1 (steady state, y_k = y_{k-1}, u_k = u_{k-1}) as (b0+b1)/(1+a1) = 0.1182/0.1182 = 1, showing it equals unity. A bare assertion of unity without evaluation earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the correct numerical difference equation (3 s.f.) and an explicit DC-gain evaluation at z=1 giving 1. Each point is all or nothing; no half marks.
